file_scope_lock_status.why_unrepairable: CI runs the trusted copy of scope-override-comment-parser.ts from origin/main, whose issue regex is /^UTV2-\d+$/. A WORK-### override is unparseable by it. This branch is what widens that regex to accept WORK-###, so the PR contains the fix for the check failing it. The check is not one of the four required contexts, so it blocks no merge.
